entry.name: jit.fill
entry.digest: Fill a matrix with a list
entry.description: Fills one plane of a named matrix with the values of a list received in its left inlet. The offset and plane attributes determine the cells to be filled. Upon completion, the jit.fill object sends a bang message out its left outlet.
